name: Universal Modder
hook: Point Claude at any game you own and it mods it — 12 engine playbooks (Unity, Unreal, Godot, Source, Bethesda, Minecraft, RE Engine, and more), 10-step loop from recon through art generation (sprites, textures, 3D, SFX, music via fal MCP) to packaging. Trending #1 globally on GitHub October 5 at 3.4k stars, up from 2.8k on October 3.

name: UI/UX Pro Max Skill
hook: v2.0's Design System Generator produces a complete tailored design system in seconds — 192 industry-specific reasoning rules, 79 UI styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 25 chart types, 16 tech stacks. 131.9k stars on GitHub, 347k+ installs in the Skillselion catalog.

name: Unreal Engine Skills for Claude Code Plugin
hook: EpicGames' official plugin gives Claude Code direct MCP control of Unreal Editor — hundreds of tools across 30+ toolsets: actors, blueprints, materials, Niagara VFX, Control Rigs, Sequencer, State Trees, widgets, the Gameplay Ability System, and automation testing. Published in Anthropic's official Claude Code plugin marketplace; install is one command. 322 stars and climbing.

name: VibeWise
hook: Claude Code plugin that puts learning first: Claude asks for your approach, examines tradeoffs, and explains unfamiliar concepts at three checkpoint types (Build, Design, Implementation) before writing a line of code. Experience level (Beginner → Advanced) adjusts explanation depth; notes live in .vibe-wise/ with no telemetry. Trending #8 globally on GitHub October 5 at 1.4k stars.

name: SEED + PAUL
hook: SEED runs a type-aware guided interview (5 project types: Application, Workflow, Client, Utility, Campaign) and produces a PLANNING.md spec ready for PAUL's build loop. PAUL (Plan-Apply-Unify Loop) enforces acceptance-driven development with Execute/Qualify per task and a STATE.md that survives session restarts — quality gates before a line of code ships. Charlie Automates called it 'the Claude Code meta nobody's talking about' in October 2026. SEED: 351 stars, MIT. PAUL: 1.2k stars.

name: cmux
hook: Open-source Ghostty-based macOS terminal built for AI coding agents — vertical tabs, notification rings when agents need attention, native pane splits for fleet orchestration, a built-in browser with scriptable API, and a CLI/socket API for workspace automation. IndyDevDan (129K subscribers) dedicated a video to driving Claude Code as a primary agent fleet controller through cmux's socket API this week. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. 27.6k stars.
install: brew tap manaflow-ai/cmux && brew install --cask cmux

name: Claude SEO
hook: Universal SEO skill for Claude Code — 26 sub-skills and 19 specialist agents cover technical audits, E-E-A-T, schema validation (20+ types), AI Overviews optimization, backlink profiling, local SEO, and international SEO in 10-15 minutes via parallel sub-agent execution. v2.4.2 adds an SEO Cockpit companion mod (Claude Code 2.1.287+ required) that spend-gates paid API calls and runs live audits. MIT, no per-domain pricing, 18.3k stars.

name: Ponytail
hook: Six-step YAGNI decision ladder before every code change: does this need to exist, is it in the codebase / stdlib / platform / deps, can it be one line? JetBrains benchmarked 15% output reduction; Chase AI's testing showed up to 50% code cuts and 53% Opus cost drop. 156k stars.

name: Caveman
hook: Forces responses into compressed caveman-speak while preserving code, commands, and exact error messages verbatim. JetBrains tested 86 Claude Code tasks: 8.5% fewer output tokens with no detectable quality change. Started as a Friday joke, hit #1 on HN with 904 points, now 109k stars.

name: jevgrep
hook: Finds code by asking what it does rather than what it says — returns relevant files, reading leads, and verbatim source excerpts for queries like 'where is JWT validation?' Creator David Zhang verified 40% agent cost reduction on SWE-bench by feeding only the relevant files instead of the full repo. IndyDevDan covered Jev-based context engineering this week. 2.1k stars.

name: coucou
hook: A tiny friend that lives in your Mac's notch — or at the top of your screen on Windows/Linux — showing every read, edit, and run step with Allow/Deny buttons for permission requests and a built-in chat pane. v0.1.6 adds Mochi desktop pet overlay; integrations for Stripe, GitHub, Vercel, n8n, Notion, and Cal.com each get a colored Mochi. macOS 15+ (Swift 6) and Windows 10/11 (Tauri 2). 3.4k stars.

name: ECC
hook: #1 on GitHub's claude-code topic with 272k stars. Wraps Claude Code with a complete SDLC: 293 reusable skills, 68 specialized agents, 94 workflow commands, AgentShield security scanning, and session-persistent memory. v2.2.3. The ethos: plan → test → implement → review → verify → remember → improve.

name: Karpathy Guidelines Skill
hook: Forrest Chang turned Andrej Karpathy's frustrations with AI coding agents into four hard behavioral rules: think before coding, make surgical changes, surface assumptions and tradeoffs, define verifiable success criteria. Most-starred Claude Code behavioral skill on GitHub at 210k stars, 35.1k installs on the skills.sh registry. Works across all major agents.

name: gstack (Garry Tan)
hook: Y Combinator's CEO open-sourced his personal Claude Code config — 23 specialist roles (CEO, designer, EM, QA lead, release engineer, and 18 more) plus 8 power tools. Work moves through a fixed loop: Think → Plan → Build → Review → Test → Ship → Reflect. Tan averaged 10,000 lines of code and 100 PRs per week over a 50-day sprint. 135k stars.

name: "You Should Know" Built-in Mod
hook: Built-in side agent that watches your session and proactively flags missed edge cases, risks in proposed changes, and dropped context — shipped in v2.1.287. v2.1.288 (Oct 2) adds Ctrl+C prompt recovery (Up arrow restores the draft), --max-findings for /code-review, $.ui.selection() for mods authors, and 61 bug fixes including mid-response API timeout recovery. Enable with: /plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin
